title: PR-001 cross-RT pilot admission snapshot v1
description: A short-lived, purpose-bound admission decision for tenants in pilot status. The provider is constructor-bound to collector_run, profile_workflow or query_broker; callers do not supply purpose per request. This snapshot contains policy metadata only, never credentials, tenant content, host paths or authorization material. It is an integrity-bound snapshot rather than a signature; production policy authority belongs to the RT-026 adapter.
semanticRules: The object has exactly the nine required properties. Unknown, missing, duplicated or non-string property names are rejected before semantic validation.

snapshot_sha256 equals SHA-256 of the ASCII domain separator cwk-pilot-admission-snapshot-v1 followed by one NUL byte and RFC 8785 JCS of the snapshot after excluding only snapshot_sha256. No other field may be excluded.
as_of and expires_at are real RFC3339 UTC timestamps at exact second precision with a trailing Z; offsets, fractions, whitespace and leap seconds are rejected.
The validity interval satisfies 0 < expires_at - as_of <= 300 seconds, inclusive at 300 seconds.
At evaluation, as_of <= now < expires_at. An expired or not-yet-valid snapshot fails closed.
tenant_id equals the injected AgentContextSnapshot tenant_id and purpose equals the constructor-bound provider purpose.
admission_policy_revision is an integer rather than a boolean and is monotonic per tenant and purpose at the consumer boundary.
admitted=false is a valid policy response but never authorizes work; a consumer requiring admission raises the stable denied result. Missing provider authority raises the stable unavailable result.
The production provider is injected by RT-026. This schema does not authorize reading environment variables, the current working directory, policy files, credentials or tenant content.
